title: I was disappointed in how the package looked when I opened it
text: I was disappointed in how the package looked when I opened it. Well I finally got the product. I was disappointed in how the package looked when I opened it. I didn't like the loose silicone still in the cups. But I washed them and followed the instructions. They tip over easy and you have to make sure the top is on correct or water gets into the egg. It took longer to cook the eggs I had to make sure that the water did not boil hard as it would get into container. I bought them for making soft eggs. It took 20 minutes to cook the eggs and I will have to play with timing as the eggs came out slightly over cooked. It cleaned up well. I will use them again. But I think I would look for something made in America as the quality was very poor.

product_metadata.title: FashionMall Kitchen Egg Cooker (pack of 6), Premium Silicone Eggs Maker, Get Hard Boiled Eggs without the Egg Shell
